items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: He had a brother named William Young called Sport. Oh sure, sure. Oh yeah.

ctx.x: You know him? No, I never knew him.
Albert Youngs. He went to base there. He had a brother named William Young called Sport. Oh sure, sure. Oh yeah.
What did you know his brother?
Oh, yeah, that's Austin Young's brother.
That's William Young's brother. Sports brother, yeah.
What kind of trombone did he play? I mean Boots, for instance.
